A primer on feeding routines at the skyport
The desk wrote this for anyone travelling with a pet
Feeding Your Pet Before and After Skyport Travel

Aurelia Skyways plans pet movement with care, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk helps travelers keep feeding routines steady through each part of the journey. A calm routine can make check-in, transfer, and arrival easier for both you and your animal.

When you prepare for travel, feed your pet in a way that matches the routine already used at home. Keep the portion familiar, and avoid adding new foods right before departure. A settled stomach is usually easier to manage during transport, and a quiet pause before check-in can help your pet stay comfortable.

<<FACT F091>>

Bring any items that support the feeding plan, such as the usual container, a familiar scoop, or a clean cloth for a tidy rest stop. If your pet uses a special schedule, note it for your own reference so you can keep the pattern consistent during the trip. Our ground team handles carriers with care between services, and good packing helps them do that smoothly.

At arrival, keep the first feeding calm and predictable. Offer water in a measured way, then return to the usual routine once your pet is settled. Avoid rushing the process, since many animals need a quiet moment after travel before they are ready to eat.

<<FACT F101>>

If your pet has a medical feeding plan, bring the needed supplies and keep them close at hand. For any further help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk through the Aurelia Skyways help center.
